frozen_reduction.union_incidence: I_sigma = union_i I_{sigma,i} on S_sigma union Components(Y0)
frozen_reduction.theorem: For every common cut/decomposition T: COMMON_LAYER_MIM(T) <= mim_{I_sigma}(T) <= 3*COMMON_LAYER_MIM(T).
frozen_reduction.consequence: The common-layout problem is reduced to constructing a bounded-mim decomposition of one explicit bipartite union-incidence graph I_sigma.

exact_goal: Using only B0/B1A/source constraints plus already sealed Fundamentum carriers, prove or falsify that I_sigma admits a polynomially constructible source-valid cut/layout certificate sufficient for a seed-bounded common boundary interface.

route_order.name: RUNNING_INTERSECTION_REUSE_CHECK
route_order.question: Can the source dependency objects induced by I_sigma be compiled into components each having a full-cut anchor and a verified running-intersection relation tree?
route_order.on_fail: Preserve exact missing precondition; do not modify carrier.

route_order.name: DISCONNECTED_FACTOR_CHECK
route_order.question: Does the complete frozen downstream dependency hypergraph split into independent connected components?
route_order.on_pass: Use FACTORIZED_FEEDBACK_INTERFACE_PORTFOLIO additively; any source/reconstruction cross-coupling forces merge.

route_order.name: SMALL_INTERACTION_COMPONENT_CHECK
route_order.question: Are all remaining cut components singleton-relation or exact two-relation components covering the cut?

route_order.name: CANONICAL_SEPARATOR_FALLBACK
route_order.question: Does an already sealed canonical mincut/single/pair separator scope apply with polynomial branch budget?
route_order.on_pass: Reuse existing separator carrier only within its exact scope.

route_order.name: COMMON_CORE_AND_GUARDED_ELIMINATION
route_order.question: Can an exact non-expanding semijoin/common-core prefilter reduce the next elimination bucket to the existing explicit row-product budget?

adequacy_contract.rule: No D1/common-layout quotient is authoritative until every future Lemma11/reconstruction query is shown to factor through it.

anti_duplication: No reproof of conditional D1 state count.
No reproof of B1A per-layer P7-free decomposition.
No reopening of G_{r,q} multiplicity/hitting-set families.
No use of code scaffolds as theorem authority.

falsifier_priority.question: Can a source-valid fixed coarse class realize an I_sigma of unbounded mim-width even though each I_{sigma,i} is P7-free and Q_sigma is P7-free?
falsifier_priority.role: If YES, the universal COMMON_LAYOUT_EXISTENCE claim is false and the router must target narrower source-certified subclasses instead of seeking one global bounded-mim theorem.
